t: This is the Old War Office Building, the former headquarters of the War Office. It was designed by William Young, a Scottish architect who also designed Glasgow City Chambers, so he was used to grand civic buildings. Working with him was his son, Clyde Francis Young, who is credited as a designer here too. Take a moment to look at the scale of it. It was built to house the administration of the army, and it still carries that sense of official importance.
